instruction: A clean, bright lifestyle photograph with a medium shot of a minimalist white dance studio. On the right foreground, the young woman in the beige sports bra (R4) stands with her arms extended straight out to the sides, looking forward. In the background on the left, the blonde girl in the beige long-sleeve crop top (R5) stands with her arms raised straight overhead, looking forward. They perform synchronized arm stretches. Soft natural light from large windows illuminates the scene, creating a neutral beige and white palette.
